# twenty_workspace

Reads the current workspace through Metadata GraphQL. It takes no arguments. The provider session is bound to one workspace, so this data source cannot select or discover other workspaces. It does not create a workspace or change settings.

Each read requests `CurrentUser` to verify the authenticated user, workspace, and membership against the configured session identity, then loads computed properties through `CurrentWorkspace`. It does not use the configuration-time snapshot or the cached workspace summary from `CurrentUser` for those properties. An identity mismatch, missing required field, or malformed response is an error.

No settings permission is required. In Twenty v2.44.0, a verified member with no explicit settings flags can read this identity even when role listing is denied.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_workspace" "current" {}

output "workspace_id" {
  value = data.twenty_workspace.current.id
}

output "default_role_id" {
  value = data.twenty_workspace.current.default_role_id
}
```

## Returned values

`id` is the workspace's native UUID. `default_role_id` identifies the workspace default, not the authenticated member's role. It can be null when no default role is set.

Display name, custom domain, custom URL, and member count preserve server nulls. Empty strings remain distinct from null. A returned member count must be a nonnegative integer; a null count is not reported as zero. The count includes workspace users, not pending invitations. It is informational, not a last-member or administrator safety check.

URLs come from Twenty and can differ from the configured endpoint, especially in single-workspace local deployments. The provider does not follow these URLs. Timestamps use RFC3339 format and preserve fractional seconds.

No member list, credentials, or session tokens are exported. Computed workspace properties appear in Terraform state. This data source is not an import target.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `activation_status` (String) Workspace activation status returned by Twenty, such as ACTIVE. The provider authenticates only active workspaces.
- `created_at` (String) Workspace creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `custom_domain` (String) Workspace custom domain, or null when none is configured.
- `custom_url` (String) Absolute workspace custom-domain URL, or null when the server has none.
- `default_role_id` (String) UUID of the workspace's default role, or null when no default role is set. This is not the authenticated member's role.
- `display_name` (String) Workspace display name, or null when the server has none.
- `id` (String) Stable UUID of the authenticated workspace.
- `subdomain` (String) Workspace subdomain returned by Twenty.
- `subdomain_url` (String) Absolute workspace subdomain URL returned by Twenty. This can differ from the configured provider endpoint.
- `updated_at` (String) Workspace last-update timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `workspace_members_count` (Number) Workspace user count returned by Twenty, excluding pending invitations. Null means the server returned no count, not zero.
